text: Albert Einstein was born in Germany in 1879.
The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure.
Neil Armstrong was the first human to walk on the Moon in 1969.
Shakespeare wrote the play The Dark Knight Rises.
The speed of light in a vacuum is approximately 299792 kilometers per second.
The human body has 206 bones in adulthood.
Python was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991.
The Eiffel Tower was built for the 1900 World's Fair.
Marie Curie won two Nobel Prizes one in Physics and one in Chemistry.
The first iPhone was released in 2007.
George Washington was the second President of the United States.
DNA carries genetic information in living organisms.
Thomas Edison invented the light bulb entirely on his own with no prior work by others.
